column2: An ancient Dwemer forge, guarded by several Dwarven automatons.
One of several ancestor glades found on Tamriel.
A medium-sized Dwarven ruin located southeast of Dushnikh Yal.
A large fort on an island far northwest of Solitude, north-northwest of Northwatch Keep.
The courtyard attached to Castle Volkihar and Volkihar Keep.
A large fort far northwest of Solitude connected to Castle Volkihar which serves as the Volkihar vampire clan's home.
A cave located just southwest of the Orc stronghold Mor Khazgur.
A small cavern which is only accessible through Darkfall Cave, and is the only access to Forgotten Vale.
The wilderness area surrounding Fort Dawnguard.
A large fort southeast of Riften which serves as the Dawnguard's base of operations.
A cave system only accessible through the southwestern section of Fort Dawnguard.
A small, unmarked bear den only accessible via Dayspring Canyon.
A large cave southwest of Dawnstar where Serana is trapped. Contains a word wall which teaches part of the Drain Vitality shout.
A small cave southeast of Dragon Bridge.
An isolated region of Skyrim once inhabited by the Snow Elves to worship the God Auri-El. (map) Contains a word wall which teaches part of the Drain Vitality shout.
A small cave found in the Forgotten Vale that is dominated by a roaring underground river.
A cave located within the Forgotten Vale, and the location of one of the rare shellbugs.
A small forest which can only be accessed using the Paragon Portal in the Forgotten Vale, with the ruby paragon.
A small isolated river valley, with falls at the southern end, that fed the frozen lake.
An immense icy cavern located within the Forgotten Vale.
A relatively well-preserved portion of the Chantry of Auri-El located within the Forgotten Vale.
A cave located within the Forgotten Vale.
A small, isolated dock far west of Solitude, near Northwatch Keep.
A small camp and concealed cave in western Whiterun Hold, occupied by vampires.
A drug den hidden beneath a dilapidated shack, supplying Redwater skooma, located west of Autumnshade Clearing.
A medium-sized cave east-southeast of Shor's Watchtower and north-northeast of Riften.
A plane of Oblivion haunted by lost Souls, added by the Dawnguard add-on.
An enclosed graveyard located in the Soul Cairn.
An enclosed ruin located in the Soul Cairn.
